tools.name: find_birthplace
tools.description: Look up a town in the Astrodai atlas (towns above about 15,000 people; places at or beyond 66 degrees latitude are not supported). Returns up to 5 candidates, each with a place_token for the other tools. Add the region or country after a comma to narrow the search. If nothing matches, try the neares

tools.name: chart_overview
tools.description: A short plain-language summary of the sidereal birth chart (True Chitrapaksha ayanamsa): the rising sign, the Moon sign and nakshatra and the Sun sign, each with a one-line meaning, and the running Vimshottari life chapter and sub-chapter (month and year). Up to 3 answers per birth date and town eve

tools.name: life_area
tools.description: A short plain-language note from the birth chart on one area of life: the area's main house, its sign and how strong it is. The planet that guides the area, its other houses, support from planets and timing are not included. Areas: career, relationships, wealth, home_property, children, education, f

tools.name: current_chapter
tools.description: The Vimshottari life chapter (mahadasha) and sub-chapter (antardasha) running today, with month and year, in plain language: what their planets stand for, the houses they sit in and guide, the life areas they touch, and when the next sub-chapter starts. Finer periods are not included. Up to 3 answer

tools.name: birth_time_check
tools.description: How sensitive the chart is to the recorded birth time, in plain language: minutes earlier or later until the rising sign changes, the same for the Moon nakshatra quarter (pada) and the D9 and D10 rising signs, and how many days the life chapter dates move per minute of birth time. tools.name: panchang
tools.description: Weekday, tithi, paksha, nakshatra, yoga and karana for a date and place, calculated at 12:00 local time unless a time is given. Sunrise, sunset and Rahu kalam are not included. Birth details are used only to calculate this answer and are not stored.
